ov: Plant-eating insects with powerful hind legs for leaping, one of the oldest groups of chewing plant-eaters. Under crowded conditions some species change colour and behaviour and swarm as locusts.

why.et: Grasshoppers are eaten in countries such as Mexico and Indonesia.

df: Plants; swarming locusts can strip crops over wide areas.
fx: Grasshoppers date back about 250 million years, to the early Triassic.
notes: Group entry (aliases cricket and locust; crickets are a separate suborder). The existing fact (ears on its abdomen) is confirmed.
